items.title: About the Most Replaced Engines UK 2026
items.description: This document presents the definitive ranking of which engines actually get replaced in the UK - based on 24,650 real engine replacement quote requests processed through EnginesMarket.co.uk between January and December 2025 [EM-VERIFIED] .

blocks.text: This is not a reliability ranking . High replacement frequency may reflect large vehicle parc, age profile, or audience bias - not engineering quality. However, for used car buyers, this data shows exactly which engines are most frequently requiring replacement and what to budget for.
This is an index, not a quote tool. For personalised pricing, use the Engines Market comparison service.

blocks.question: What is the most replaced engine in the UK? +
blocks.answer: The BMW N47D20C is the most replaced engine in the UK, with 1,450 quote requests in 2025 [EM-VERIFIED] . This 2.0-litre diesel engine is found in BMW 3 Series, 1 Series, 5 Series, X1, and X3 models. The primary failure is timing chain stretch, particularly on the rear-mounted chain.

blocks.question: Is the most replaced engine the most unreliable? +
blocks.answer: No. High replacement frequency may reflect large vehicle parc (many on the road), age profile, or audience bias - not engineering quality. For example, the VW EA189 2.0 TDI is #4 with 1,050 requests, partly because millions were sold in the UK.

blocks.question: How much does it cost to replace a BMW N47 engine? +
blocks.answer: A reconditioned BMW N47D20C costs £3,200-£5,500 supply-only, or £3,850-£6,410 fitted [EM-QUOTE] . Used options start from £1,800-£3,200 supply-only. Fitting costs depend on your region and garage.

blocks.question: Why are Land Rover engines so prominent in the top 15? +
blocks.answer: Land Rover engines occupy 4 of the top 10 spots (204DTD, 306DT SDV6, 276DT, 368DT). This is due to a combination of known engineering issues (timing chain tensioners, crankshaft bearings, oil pump housings), high vehicle values that justify replacement, and a large premium SUV parc in the UK.

blocks.question: Is it worth replacing a Ford DV6 1.6 TDCi engine? +
blocks.answer: The Ford DV6 1.6 TDCi is flagged as a 🔴 Scrap Threshold engine. With fitted costs of £1,590-£2,720 and typical vehicle values of £1,200-£5,000, replacement often exceeds the car's value. Consider scrapping unless the car is in excellent condition.

blocks.question: Why does reconditioned cost more than used? +
blocks.answer: Reconditioned engines are disassembled, cleaned, and have worn parts replaced (pistons, rings, bearings, seals). They are tested to standard and come with a 6-12 month warranty. Used engines are direct from donor vehicles with unknown history.

blocks.question: What should I consider when deciding repair vs. scrap? +
blocks.answer: If the fitted replacement cost exceeds approximately 60% of the vehicle's current market value, consider scrapping. However, rare, collectable, or sentimental vehicles may justify spending above this threshold. Check our engine replacement cost guide for more guidance.
